concerns.text: FR-009 requires a pre-study pilot check (n=5) validating SART/Ospan response times (100–5000 ms) AND that scoring logic matches the OSF reference implementation before recruitment. Tasks only implement RT range checks and unit tests of self-written scorers; no task performs the n=5 pilot or a comparison against the OSF reference implementation. The coverage table maps FR-009 to 'low-attention check', which is a different requirement — a silent weakening.

T006 states 'fallback to Wilcoxon signed-rank only if Shapiro-Wilk p < 0.05 AND bootstrap fails' — adding a 'bootstrap fails' conjunct not present in FR-006 ('if bootstrapping fails, it MUST fallback... triggered only if Shapiro-Wilk p < 0.05' is itself ambiguous, but T006 invents a third condition). Pick the trigger rule and align spec/plan/task; do not let the task silently redefine the fallback.

FR-008 and SC-005 define the Holm-Bonferroni family as FOUR outcome variables / four comparisons, but T006 corrects across 5 metrics (SART, Ospan, PSS-10, PANAS-PA, PANAS-NA). Family size changes the correction math; the task must not silently widen the family without the spec being amended.

FR-001–FR-004 require participant recruitment, web-administered SART/Ospan tasks, questionnaire administration, and a daily participant logging interface; Principle VII requires the intervention to be an actual behavioral modification of self-reported engagement. Every task operates exclusively on seeded simulated data with no participant-facing mechanism, and the tasks header frames this as the full study rather than a documented pipeline-validation phase. Either the spec must be explicitly narrowed/staged (documented justification) or tasks for the administration interfaces must exist — as written, tasks claim FR coverage they do not deliver.

T010 requires 'evaluation of SC-001 through SC-005' against results computed from synthetic seeded data (T003). SCs are defined as statistically significant changes with d ≥ 0.2 in the study population; evaluating them against fabricated numbers is a semantic weakening unless the tasks/spec explicitly state the SCs are deferred to a real-data phase or evaluated only as pipeline-mechanics checks.

FR-011 permits documenting the self-report limitation 'if objective screen-time data [is] not available' — T008 takes the documentation branch, which is acceptable, but the task should state explicitly that the objective-comparison branch was assessed and unavailable, not silently default to documentation.
